## `get_project_principal_investigator`

*Available in [Python](#get_project_principal_investigator-python), [CLI](#get_project_principal_investigator-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Retrieves the principal investigator field of a CIDA project.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_project_principal_investigator(
        project: CIDAProject
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - The CIDA project to retrieve the principal investigator for. If none is specified, uses the value of `current_project()`.

    <h4>Returns `str | None`</h4>

    Returns the principal investigator or None.
